opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government. Applicants must be ordinarily resident in Scotland (or have a substantial recent connection), be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK (or have Limited Leave to Remain / be an asylum seeker), not be eligible for public funds towards tuition fees, and be enrolled on (or hold an unconditional offer for) an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish higher education institution. Household income thresholds apply.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for students from low-income households who are not eligible for government tuition fee funding, studying an undergraduate degree at a Scottish institution. Applications are processed on a first-come-first-served basis, with a second-degree route available for those reskilling in skills-shortage areas.
